================ 0011-tts-answer-websocket-ping-keepalive ================
From a4ec3355e70d11810d7f5a037b0809a464c592dc Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: [REDACTED-USER-ID] <[REDACTED-USER-ID]@qq.com>
Date: Thu, 27 Aug 2026 10:48:10 +0800
Subject: [PATCH 6/6] tts: answer WebSocket PING so long syntheses stay alive

The big-model TTS server keeps the ws_binary connection warm with
standard WebSocket PING frames; if the client does not echo a PONG the
link can drop in the middle of a long sentence (observed as
'rc=-104' after ~18 chunks).  Handle PING by reflecting PONG with the
same payload (including an empty one) and ignore peer PONGs, before
the Volcengine-frame parsing so short control frames are not dropped.

Also generalize the send helper to carry any opcode; the existing
binary path is unchanged.
---
 src/voice/volc_tts_ws.c | 46 +++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++----
 1 file changed, 42 insertions(+), 4 deletions(-)

diff --git a/src/voice/volc_tts_ws.c b/src/voice/volc_tts_ws.c
index 381b9f2..437eaaf 100644
--- a/src/voice/volc_tts_ws.c
+++ b/src/voice/volc_tts_ws.c
@@ -64,8 +64,12 @@ static const char* TAG = "volc_tts_ws";
 /* WebSocket constants */
 #define WS_BUF_SIZE (32 * 1024)
 #define WS_MASK_KEY_LEN 4
+#define WS_OPCODE_PING 0x09
+#define WS_OPCODE_PONG 0x0A
 #define WS_OPCODE_BINARY 0x02
 #define WS_OPCODE_CLOSE 0x08
 #define WS_FIN_BIT 0x80
 #define WS_MASK_BIT 0x80
 
@@ -311,13 +315,13 @@ static int ws_upgrade(tts_tls_ctx_t* ctx, const char* host, const char* path,
 
 /* ── WebSocket frame send (client must mask) ─────────────────── */
 
-static int ws_send_binary(tts_tls_ctx_t* ctx, const unsigned char* payload,
-    size_t plen)
+static int ws_send_frame(tts_tls_ctx_t* ctx, int opcode,
+    const unsigned char* payload, size_t plen)
 {
     unsigned char hdr[14];
     size_t hdr_len = 0;
 
-    hdr[0] = WS_FIN_BIT | WS_OPCODE_BINARY;
+    hdr[0] = WS_FIN_BIT | (unsigned char)opcode;
 
     if (plen < 126) {
         hdr[1] = WS_MASK_BIT | (unsigned char)plen;
@@ -374,6 +378,17 @@ static int ws_send_binary(tts_tls_ctx_t* ctx, const unsigned char* payload,
     return 0;
 }
 
+/* Send a PONG echoing a received PING payload, keeping the connection
+ * alive across long synthesis.  Muted writes are not fatal; the caller's
+ * next recv timeout would surface a dead link anyway.
+ */
+
+static int ws_send_pong(tts_tls_ctx_t* ctx, const unsigned char* payload,
+    size_t plen)
+{
+    return ws_send_frame(ctx, WS_OPCODE_PONG, payload, plen);
+}
+
 /* ── WebSocket frame recv ────────────────────────────────────── */
 
 static int ws_recv_frame(tts_tls_ctx_t* ctx, unsigned char* buf, size_t cap,
@@ -466,7 +481,8 @@ static int send_volc_frame(tts_tls_ctx_t* ctx, unsigned char msg_type,
         memcpy(frame + VOLC_HDR_SIZE, payload, plen);
     }
 
-    int ret = ws_send_binary(ctx, frame, VOLC_HDR_SIZE + plen);
+    int ret = ws_send_frame(ctx, WS_OPCODE_BINARY,
+        frame, VOLC_HDR_SIZE + plen);
 
     free(frame);
     return ret;
@@ -601,6 +617,28 @@ static int recv_tts_audio(tts_tls_ctx_t* ctx, volc_tts_chunk_cb cb,
             break;
         }
 
+        /* Answer the server's WebSocket keepalive.  These frames carry
+         * their own opcode outside the Volcengine envelope and may be
+         * shorter than 4 bytes, so they are handled before the "too
+         * short" guard below.  The payload echoed by PONG is whatever
+         * the server sent in the PING (possibly empty). */
+
+        if (opcode == WS_OPCODE_PING) {
+            if (flen > WS_BUF_SIZE) {
+                flen = WS_BUF_SIZE;
+            }
+
+            if (ws_send_pong(ctx, buf, flen) != 0) {
+                syslog(LOG_WARNING, "[%s] PONG send failed\n", TAG);
+            }
+
+            continue;
+        }
+
+        if (opcode == WS_OPCODE_PONG) {
+            continue; /* nothing to do with a peer PONG */
+        }
+
         if (flen < 4) {
             continue;
         }
--

================ 0012-voice-preroll-tts-pcm-before-start ================
From 4e98f3914c82754e4b3adfdd359c66e00f4368b7 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: [REDACTED-USER-ID] <[REDACTED-USER-ID]@qq.com>
Date: Thu, 27 Aug 2026 10:57:53 +0800
Subject: [PATCH 7/7] voice: preroll TTS PCM before starting the player

Streaming TTS wrote the first bytes into a player whose queue was
nearly empty, so any network stall in the first ~200-300ms of a
sentence drained the queue and produced the 'playback -> silence ->
playback' underrun heard on the device.  Buffer the first
AGENT_TTS_PREROLL_MS (default 250ms) of PCM in audio_playback_open,
then issue media_player_start() once in audio_playback_write when the
threshold is crossed; the framework's own queue-full start threshold
aligns with real playback.  Short replies that end before preroll is
reached are closed without ever starting (logged), which is safe.

Includes a sleep-free close path: stop+close still clean the queue.
---
 include/agent_config.h     |  9 +++++++
 src/voice/audio_playback.c | 55 +++++++++++++++++++++++++++++---------
 2 files changed, 51 insertions(+), 13 deletions(-)

diff --git a/include/agent_config.h b/include/agent_config.h
index 516be1d..3d84880 100644
--- a/include/agent_config.h
+++ b/include/agent_config.h
@@ -405,6 +405,15 @@
 #define AGENT_TTS_WS_SAMPLE_RATE 16000
 #endif
 
+/* How much TTS PCM (in milliseconds) to buffer before the playback device
+ * starts consuming, guarding the start of a sentence against network
+ * jitter.  Too low lets the first chunk underrun; too high adds perceived
+ * latency to every reply.  200-300ms is a good balance for streaming TTS.
+ */
+#ifndef AGENT_TTS_PREROLL_MS
+#define AGENT_TTS_PREROLL_MS 250
+#endif
+
 /* ── Tool Guard (security) ──────────────────────────────────── */
 #define AGENT_TOOL_MAX_INPUT_LEN (32 * 1024)
 #define AGENT_TOOL_RATE_LIMIT_WINDOW_SEC 60
diff --git a/src/voice/audio_playback.c b/src/voice/audio_playback.c
index 6e8361a..9a978c9 100644
--- a/src/voice/audio_playback.c
+++ b/src/voice/audio_playback.c
@@ -37,7 +37,9 @@ struct audio_playback {
     void* player;
     size_t total_written;
     int bytes_per_frame;
+    size_t preroll_bytes;   /* PCM buffered before the player starts */
     volatile int stopped;
+    int started;            /* media_player_start() not yet issued */
 };
 
 audio_playback_t* audio_playback_open(const char* dev_path,
@@ -73,13 +75,6 @@ audio_playback_t* audio_playback_open(const char* dev_path,
         return NULL;
     }
 
-    ret = media_player_start(player);
-    if (ret < 0) {
-        syslog(LOG_ERR, "[%s] start failed: %d\n", TAG, ret);
-        media_player_close(player, 0);
-        return NULL;
-    }
-
     audio_playback_t* pb = calloc(1, sizeof(*pb));
     if (!pb) {
         media_player_close(player, 0);
@@ -88,10 +83,18 @@ audio_playback_t* audio_playback_open(const char* dev_path,
 
     pb->player = player;
     pb->bytes_per_frame = (bits_per_sample / 8) * channels;
+    pb->preroll_bytes = (size_t)AGENT_TTS_PREROLL_MS *
+        (size_t)sample_rate * (size_t)pb->bytes_per_frame / 1000u;
     s_active_player = player;
 
-    syslog(LOG_INFO, "[%s] opened (%uHz %uch %ubit)\n",
-        TAG, sample_rate, channels, bits_per_sample);
+    /* Do not start yet: the first AGENT_TTS_PREROLL_MS of PCM is buffered
+     * before the player goes live (see audio_playback_write), so a jittery
+     * network cannot drain the queue and cause 'playback -> silence ->
+     * playback' underruns at the start of the sentence. */
+
+    syslog(LOG_INFO, "[%s] opened (%uHz %uch %ubit), "
+        "preroll=%zu bytes before start\n",
+        TAG, sample_rate, channels, bits_per_sample, pb->preroll_bytes);
     return pb;
 }
 
@@ -106,8 +109,33 @@ int audio_playback_write(audio_playback_t* pb, const void* buf, size_t len)
     }
 
     ssize_t n = media_player_write_data(pb->player, buf, len);
-    if (n > 0) {
-        pb->total_written += (size_t)n;
+    if (n <= 0) {
+        return (int)n;
+    }
+
+    pb->total_written += (size_t)n;
+
+    /* Preroll: hold off media_player_start until the first chunk(s) have
+     * filled AGENT_TTS_PREROLL_MS of PCM.  Unless this is done, the very

/* audio_playback.c - Streaming audio playback via media_player buffer mode. */

#include "voice/audio_playback.h"
#include "agent_config.h"

#include <errno.h>
#include <media_player.h>
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>
#include <syslog.h>
#include <unistd.h>

static const char* TAG = "audio_pb";

#define PB_OPTIONS_LEN 128

static void* s_active_player;

struct audio_playback {
    void* player;
    size_t total_written;
    int bytes_per_frame;
    volatile int stopped;
};

audio_playback_t* audio_playback_open(const char* dev_path,
    unsigned int sample_rate, unsigned int channels,
    unsigned int bits_per_sample)
{
    (void)dev_path;

    if (s_active_player) {
        syslog(LOG_WARNING, "[%s] force closing stale player\n", TAG);
        media_player_stop(s_active_player);
        media_player_close(s_active_player, 0);
        s_active_player = NULL;
        usleep(100000);
    }

    void* player = media_player_open(MEDIA_STREAM_MUSIC);
    if (!player) {
        syslog(LOG_ERR, "[%s] media_player_open failed\n", TAG);
        return NULL;
    }

    char opts[PB_OPTIONS_LEN];
    snprintf(opts, sizeof(opts),
        "format=s%ule:sample_rate=%u:ch_layout=%s",
        bits_per_sample, sample_rate,
        (channels == 1) ? "mono" : "stereo");

    int ret = media_player_prepare(player, NULL, opts);
    if (ret < 0) {
        syslog(LOG_ERR, "[%s] prepare failed: %d\n", TAG, ret);
        media_player_close(player, 0);
        return NULL;
    }

    ret = media_player_start(player);
    if (ret < 0) {
        syslog(LOG_ERR, "[%s] start failed: %d\n", TAG, ret);
        media_player_close(player, 0);
        return NULL;
    }

    audio_playback_t* pb = calloc(1, sizeof(*pb));
    if (!pb) {
        media_player_close(player, 0);
        return NULL;
    }

    pb->player = player;
    pb->bytes_per_frame = (bits_per_sample / 8) * channels;
    s_active_player = player;

    syslog(LOG_INFO, "[%s] opened (%uHz %uch %ubit)\n",
        TAG, sample_rate, channels, bits_per_sample);
    return pb;
}

int audio_playback_write(audio_playback_t* pb, const void* buf, size_t len)
{
    if (!pb || !pb->player || !buf || len == 0) {
        return -EINVAL;
    }

    if (pb->stopped) {
        return -ECANCELED;
    }

    ssize_t n = media_player_write_data(pb->player, buf, len);
    if (n > 0) {
        pb->total_written += (size_t)n;
    }

    return (int)n;
}

void audio_playback_stop(audio_playback_t* pb)
{
    if (pb) {
        pb->stopped = 1;
        if (pb->player) {
            media_player_stop(pb->player);
        }
    }
}

void audio_playback_close(audio_playback_t* pb)
{
    if (!pb) {
        return;
    }

    if (pb->player) {
        syslog(LOG_INFO, "[%s] closing (%zu bytes written)\n",
            TAG, pb->total_written);
        media_player_stop(pb->player);
        usleep(50 * 1000);
        media_player_close(pb->player, 0);
        s_active_player = NULL;
    }

    free(pb);
}

- 0009:关闭时打印真实播放时长(字节数 ÷ 采样率反推),不再只打字节数
- 0012:开播前先缓冲 `AGENT_TTS_PREROLL_MS`(默认 250ms)的 PCM 再启动播放器,防止句首网络抖动导致"播放-静音-播放"的破音

# External source overlay

`external/` is a single source overlay for repositories that are not committed through the team repository. Its four target directories are deliberately flat and mirror destination repository paths exactly:

```text
external/
├── apps/                 -> <openvela>/apps/
├── nuttx/                -> <openvela>/nuttx/
├── packages/ai_agent/    -> <openvela>/packages/ai_agent/
└── bk_avdk_smp/          -> <workspace>/bk_avdk_smp/
```

There are no patch directories inside this tree. Every managed path is the complete desired target file. Root-level `manifest.tsv` pins the public source baseline and build image; `prepare.sh` is the only installation and verification entry point.

## Prepare a clean workspace

Initialize and sync OpenVela as described in `docs/github开发指南.md`, then obtain the Beken SDK at the pinned public baseline:

```bash
git clone https://github.com/bekencorp/bk_avdk_smp.git ../bk_avdk_smp
git -C ../bk_avdk_smp checkout d2ded037798530175e5dc5cde6fa1878f5d5ef35
```

From the team repository, run a full preflight and install all four overlays with per-file atomic replacement:

```bash
./external/prepare.sh install
./external/prepare.sh check
```

For a nonstandard layout, provide explicit roots:

```bash
./external/prepare.sh install \
  --openvela-root /path/to/openvela \
  --bk-avdk-root /path/to/bk_avdk_smp
```

The installer is intentionally conservative:

- It strictly validates the four repository mappings, manifest schema and pinned image/archive identifiers; `build_and_flash.sh` checks the local image ID, while an offline archive is verified with the documented `sha256sum` command.
- Each target HEAD must be the pinned commit or its descendant; an unrelated lineage is rejected even when all managed files happen to match.
- The expected 1 + 1 + 14 + 39 files are locked by per-repository count and a digest of every relative path and file hash.
- It rejects overlay symlinks, special files, target symlink components and paths that escape a target repository.
- It validates every repository and managed file, stages changed sources, then revalidates every destination before writing anything.
- A target may already equal the overlay, equal its pinned baseline blob, or be a new file absent from that baseline.
- A descendant commit is accepted only when each managed target still equals the pinned blob or the final overlay.
- Unknown local modifications abort the whole install before the first write.
- Unrelated untracked or modified files are preserved.
- Only `projects/app_ab/partitions/bk7258/auto_partitions.csv` permits CRLF/LF-only equivalence; all other files are byte-exact.
- The one known generated source mutation, `projects/app_ab/cp/config/bk7258/config`, may be restored only on a baseline-compatible checkout when it has Armino's generated-file marker and shape.

`check` is always read-only. Each changed file is installed through a temporary file in its destination directory followed by atomic rename. The 55 replacements cannot form one filesystem transaction across four repositories: if the process is interrupted during replacement, rerun `install` to safely complete the already-preflighted prefix. `install` never runs `git reset`, `checkout`, `restore`, `clean` or `stash`.

## Pinned inputs

`manifest.tsv` is authoritative. The current tested baselines are:

| Repository | Commit |
| --- | --- |
| `apps` | `dcc6a95c3b323e533c98fde8fb209f99e24f0fdd` |
| `nuttx` | `4a67a7bad6bba672db2ac37a64acbdc3c024d6e5` |
| `packages/ai_agent` | `31faed70f683a6f5e690437c5507891360f0814a` |
| `bk_avdk_smp` | `d2ded037798530175e5dc5cde6fa1878f5d5ef35` |

The complete Armino overlay includes both partition inputs:

```text
external/bk_avdk_smp/projects/app_ab/partitions/bk7258/auto_partitions.csv
external/bk_avdk_smp/projects/app_ab/partitions/bk7258/ram_regions.csv
```

`auto_partitions.csv` fixes `primary_ap_app` at `4148k`. The overlay also includes `tools/build_tools/build_process/bk_sdk/bk_sdk_project.py`, which implements the `EXTERNAL_AP_BIN` packaging path.

Do not add expanded/generated inputs such as:

```text
bk_avdk_smp/build/**
bk_avdk_smp/projects/app_ab/build/**
bk_avdk_smp/**/__pycache__/**
bk_avdk_smp/projects/app_ab/ap/config/bk7258_ap/config
```

The checked-in CP config is the minimal seed, not the expanded Kconfig output.

## Armino 1.5 image

The final CP build uses `localhost/bekencorp/armino-idk:1.5`. Official sources documented by Beken are:

- [Docker Hub tags](https://hub.docker.com/r/bekencorp/armino-idk/tags)
- [Beken image downloads](https://dl.bekencorp.com/tools/arminosdk/docker_img/armino-idk)

Pull and assign the local tag with Podman:

```bash
podman pull docker.io/bekencorp/armino-idk:1.5
podman tag docker.io/bekencorp/armino-idk:1.5 \
  localhost/bekencorp/armino-idk:1.5
```

Or load Beken's archive:

```bash
sha256sum bekencorp-armino-idk-v1.5.tar.gz
podman load -i bekencorp-armino-idk-v1.5.tar.gz
```

The tested archive SHA-256 is `d79a8ec193dafdb27af881a847fd6d3083e5804808c49b890956cbd9dae10a79`; the tested image ID is `5617808dab7ae97336fbd58beb37387bb563e0aeef50234b7beca7e8fce01d2d`. The build refuses a different image unless the pinned metadata is intentionally updated and revalidated.

## Build

Verify or explicitly install the overlay before building:

```bash
./build_and_flash.sh --prepare-overlay
```

Without `--prepare-overlay`, the build performs a read-only overlay check and stops if preparation is incomplete. It then builds OpenVela AP, injects it through `EXTERNAL_AP_BIN`, builds Armino CP and packages `all-app.bin`. The build restores the minimal CP config even when the Armino command fails.

## Updating an external file

1. Start from the pinned target repository commit.
2. Apply and test the source change in its real repository.
3. Copy the complete final file to the identical relative path under the corresponding `external/<repository>/` directory.
4. Recompute that repository row's `file_count` and `overlay_tree_sha256`; the digest is SHA-256 over sorted `relative-path<TAB>file-sha256` records, one LF-terminated record per file.
5. Run `./external/prepare.sh check` against the prepared workspace.
6. If rebasing a target repository or image intentionally, update `manifest.tsv` and this document in the same change.

Public-stack fixes should still be submitted upstream. This overlay exists to make the exact product build reproducible until those fixes are merged.

</content>

**补丁方式的两个真实翻车点,都是我今天亲手撞到的：**

1. **隐式顺序依赖**——0012 补丁要求 0009 已经先应用过(它往 `audio_playback.c` 的 struct 里加了 `preroll_bytes` 字段,0012 才能用)。我 `git apply --check 0012.patch` 直接失败,补丁本身完全没有任何地方声明这个依赖,只能靠试。补丁数量一旦超过几个,这种隐式顺序会越来越难追踪。

2. **编号在并发编辑下会失控**——upstream 那边不得不整个删掉 0006-0009,重新编号成 0006-0012,原因就是两个人各自独立在改同一批文件。编号本身变成了需要协商的资源。complete-file overlay 没有编号这个概念,我合并对方修复时就是直接编辑三个文件、跑 diff,没有任何"这个补丁该排第几"的问题。

**更根本的一点**:manifest.tsv 的 SHA-256 给出的是"最终态"的保证——这个文件的字节内容就是编译进去的那份,`prepare.sh check` 能机械地检测漂移。补丁方式保证的是"过程"(从某个 baseline 顺序应用干净),这两者不等价。补丁自己的文档就写了一次真实事故:0005 之所以存在,是因为有个改动"确实在工作树里、确实被编译烧录过,但没被存成补丁",导致 fresh checkout 之后悄无声息地缺失了这个修复。这正是内容寻址型 overlay 结构性免疫的那类问题。

**补丁真正赢的一点**:它天生就是给 upstream PR 用的格式,`git am` 就能直接拿去提交。overlay 的完整文件想变成一个干净的 upstream PR,还得手动 diff 出真正的改动点——这是额外一步。overlay 自己的 README 也承认这点,只是判断"本地可复现"比"随时能拿去提 PR"更重要,把这个翻译成本放到真正要提 PR 那一刻再付。

结论:对一个要保证"仓库历史里的代码 = 实际烧录的二进制"的比赛仓来说,overlay 的字节级校验保证,比补丁省下的那点提 PR 的便利更值钱——尤其是在像刚才这样多人同时改 `packages/ai_agent` 的情况下,差距会更明显。

两者的核心区别在于:补丁记录的是"变化",overlay记录的是"结果"。这个区别决定了它们各自怎么验证正确性。

## 补丁(patch)的原理

补丁文件是 unified diff 格式,内容大致是:

```diff
@@ -499,7 +499,10 @@ static int send_tts_request(...)
     cJSON_AddStringToObject(audio, "voice_type", s_speaker);
     cJSON_AddStringToObject(audio, "encoding", "pcm");
-    cJSON_AddNumberToObject(audio, "sample_rate", AGENT_TTS_WS_SAMPLE_RATE);
+    /* 注释 */
+    cJSON_AddNumberToObject(audio, "rate", AGENT_TTS_WS_SAMPLE_RATE);
     cJSON_AddNumberToObject(audio, "speed_ratio", 1.0);
```

`git apply` 或 `patch` 执行这个补丁时,不是"把某个文件替换成什么样",而是:

1. 在目标文件里搜索 `@@` 后面标注的上下文行(那几行没有 `+`/`-` 的部分),用它们来**定位**该在哪一行动手
2. 找到位置后,删掉 `-` 开头的行,插入 `+` 开头的行

所以补丁的有效性完全依赖于两件事:目标文件当前内容必须和补丁产生时的"before"状态足够接近(至少上下文行得对得上,差太多就 hunk failed),以及多个补丁必须按固定顺序应用——因为补丁 B 的上下文可能是补丁 A 打完之后才出现的内容。

这正是我今天撞到的 0012 依赖 0009 的原因:0012 的 diff 上下文里包含 `preroll_bytes` 这个字段,而这个字段是 0009 往 struct 里加的。0009 没先打,0012 想匹配的那几行上下文根本不存在,`git apply --check` 直接报错。补丁文件本身不会声明"我依赖 0009",这个顺序关系只存在于文件编号的隐含约定里。

补丁式的 `apply.sh` 本质上就是对一个目录按编号顺序循环跑 `patch -p1` 或 `git apply`。

## Overlay 的原理

overlay 目录下存的不是改动,是那个文件改完之后的**完整内容**。验证和安装的核心操作是 `cmp -s`(逐字节比较),不涉及任何文本定位。具体到 `prepare.sh` 里:

**check 模式**——对 manifest 里列出的每一对 `(overlay 文件, 目标文件)` 直接 `cmp`:

```bash
if [ -f "$destination" ] && [ ! -L "$destination" ] \
  && cmp -s -- "$BASELINE_BLOB" "$destination"; then
```

相同就是 ready,不同就报 `overlay mismatch`。没有"应用"这个动作,只有"比较"。

**install 模式**——对不相同的文件,先判断目标当前内容属于哪一种状态,只有三种情况允许覆盖:

- 等于 pinned baseline 的原始 blob(用 `git cat-file blob <baseline>:<path>` 取出来跟目标 `cmp`)
- 等于 overlay 本身(已经装过了,是幂等的)
- 目标路径完全不存在(全新文件)

除此之外一律视为"未知修改",整个 install 直接中止,不写任何文件。这正是今天我卡住的地方:老 overlay 的内容已经写进了 live tree,新 overlay 又改了这两个文件的内容,导致目标文件既不等于 baseline 也不等于新 overlay,被判定为未知修改而拒绝覆盖——我得先把这两个文件手动 reset 回 baseline blob,才能让它落入"等于 baseline"这一档,允许安装。

写入方式是同目录临时文件 + `mv` 原子替换,而且是**先把全部 56 个文件校验完,再统一开始写**——不会出现"写了一半"的中间状态。

manifest.tsv 里那行 sha256,是对整个 overlay 目录算的一个总校验和:所有文件按路径排序,拼成 `路径\t文件自身sha256` 的记录,再对这一整块文本算一次 sha256。这个值锁定的是"overlay 目录当前内容"这一个具体状态,跟"怎么从旧状态变成这个状态"完全无关。

## 结构性差异落到哪

补丁的正确性依赖一整条链:从 baseline 出发,按顺序应用 A、再应用 B、再应用 C,每一步的中间态都要能被下一步接受。要验证"补丁体系是对的",得把这条链完整跑一遍。

overlay 的正确性只需要一个断言:这个文件现在的字节内容,hash 是不是等于我声明的那个值。跟它昨天是什么样、经过了几步、谁先改谁后改,没有关系。

这也是为什么补丁需要编号(维护应用顺序这个隐含状态),而 overlay 不需要——每个文件的校验是独立的,互不依赖,自然也就没有"先后"这个概念要维护。

这个问题有两层,分别答。

## 第一层:为什么不能直接改 `packages/ai_agent` 里的源码文件

`packages/ai_agent` 根本不是 contest 仓库的一部分,是完全独立的一个 git 仓库(`openvela/packages_ai_agent`),repo 工具按 manifest 检出到这个路径。刚才我试着在 contest 仓库里对这个路径跑 `git status`:

```
fatal: ../packages：'../packages' 在位于 'contest2026_264_VelaSightsuixingAIzhinengyanjing' 的仓库之外
```

物理上不在同一个仓库里,contest 仓库的 commit 历史根本装不下 `packages/ai_agent` 下的改动——不是权限问题,是这条路径对 contest 仓库的 git 来说不存在。

而比赛规则(`docs/github开发指南.md`)又写死了 contest 仓库是"唯一提交仓库",评审只看这一个仓库的历史。所以哪怕真去改了 `packages_ai_agent` 自己的仓库,那个改动也不算比赛提交的一部分,除非发 PR 被 upstream 合并——合并要审核、要时间,不是我们说改就能立刻算数的。

所以现实约束是:要改的文件活在一个我们不能提交的仓库里,能提交的只有 contest 仓库这一份。补丁和 overlay 都是在解决同一件事——怎么把"改了 `packages/ai_agent` 才生效"这个事实,存进 contest 仓库能装下的形式里。

## 第二层:既然存的是完整文件,为什么不直接复制过去就行,还要 manifest.tsv 和 prepare.sh 这一套

这个问题问到了点上。存完整文件这个动作本身没问题,`external/packages/ai_agent/` 下的文件确实就是复制过去的完整内容。缺 manifest+校验的话,缺的是**保证这份复制品和"真正参与编译的那份"随时对得上**这件事。

裸复制会在这几个地方出问题:

**没人知道这份复制品对应哪个版本**。`packages/ai_agent` 自己有独立的 commit 历史,今天是这个内容,明天上游一个 PR 合并进去可能就变了。裸复制的文件躺在 contest 仓库里,没有任何字段说"这份是基于 upstream 哪个 commit 改的",review 的人没法判断这份代码相对 baseline 到底改了什么。

**没人知道复制生效了没有**。`repo sync` 出来的 `packages/ai_agent` 是它自己仓库的原始内容,跟 contest 仓库里的复制品是两份独立拷贝,没有任何自动机制把二者对齐。今天我改完三个文件的内容后,先跑 `check` 就直接报出来:

```
prepare.sh: error: packages_ai_agent overlay mismatch: include/agent_config.h
```

如果是裸复制,不会有这条检测——你可能改了 overlay 里的文件,但忘了同步到实际编译目录,构建用的还是旧代码,而你以为已经生效了。

**覆盖会覆盖错东西**。今天跑 `install` 时它直接拒绝了:

```
prepare.sh: error: packages_ai_agent refuses to overwrite unknown modification: include/agent_config.h
```

因为那两个目标文件当时既不等于 pinned baseline、也不等于新 overlay——它们是介于两者之间的旧 overlay 内容。这套机制在覆盖前会先判断目标处于三种已知状态之一(等于 baseline / 等于当前 overlay / 全新文件)才允许写,否则整个 install 中止、一个字节都不写。裸复制(`cp -r` 之类)没有这个判断,会直接把目标不管是什么内容都覆盖掉——如果目标那份是别人在本地做的、还没保存到任何地方的手工调试改动,就这么被无声吞掉了。

**文件数变了没人发现**。今天新增 `audio_playback.c` 后,overlay 从 14 个文件变成 15 个,manifest.tsv 里那一行以及 `prepare.sh` 里硬编码的校验数字都得同步改成 15/56。这两处如果漏改一个,`prepare.sh check` 会直接报 `schema` 错误拒绝往下走。裸复制不会有这种强制提醒,数量对不对全靠人记。

一句话总结:**存完整文件解决的是"这里有没有这份代码",manifest+prepare.sh 解决的是"这份代码和最终编译出的二进制,任何时候拿出来对,都对得上"**——后者是前者不自动附带的保证,得靠这套脚本机械地补上。
这套现有机制工作的流程是什么

#!/bin/sh

# Install or verify the complete external source overlay.
#
# The external/ directory mirrors target repository paths.  This script is
# intentionally conservative: it validates the manifest and preflights every
# managed file before writing any of them.  It refuses to overwrite content
# that is neither the pinned baseline nor the already-installed overlay.
############################################################################

set -eu

SCRIPT_DIR=$(CDPATH= cd -- "$(dirname -- "$0")" && pwd -P)
PROJECT_ROOT=$(CDPATH= cd -- "$SCRIPT_DIR/.." && pwd -P)
MANIFEST="$SCRIPT_DIR/manifest.tsv"

MODE=check
OPENVELA_ROOT=${OPENVELA_ROOT:-}
BK_AVDK_ROOT=${BK_AVDK_ROOT:-}

usage()
{

usage: external/prepare.sh [check|install] [options]

options:
  --openvela-root PATH  OpenVela repo workspace (contains apps/nuttx/packages)
  --bk-avdk-root PATH   Beken bk_avdk_smp checkout
  -h, --help            Show this help

check is read-only. install validates the complete 56-file overlay first, then
uses a same-directory temporary file and atomic rename for each changed path.
Unknown modifications abort before the first managed file is written.
EOF
}

fatal()
{
  echo "prepare.sh: $*" >&2
  exit 1
}

while [ "$#" -gt 0 ]; do
  case "$1" in
    check|install)
      MODE=$1
      ;;
    --openvela-root)
      shift
      [ "$#" -gt 0 ] || { echo "prepare.sh: missing --openvela-root value" >&2; exit 2; }
      OPENVELA_ROOT=$1

    --bk-avdk-root)

      BK_AVDK_ROOT=$1
      ;;
    -h|--help)
      usage
      exit 0
      ;;
    *)

      usage >&2
      exit 2
      ;;
  esac

done

[ -f "$MANIFEST" ] || fatal "missing $MANIFEST"

if [ -z "$OPENVELA_ROOT" ]; then
  OPENVELA_ROOT=$(CDPATH= cd -- "$PROJECT_ROOT/.." && pwd -P)
else
  [ -d "$OPENVELA_ROOT" ] || fatal "OpenVela root is not a directory: $OPENVELA_ROOT"
  OPENVELA_ROOT=$(CDPATH= cd -- "$OPENVELA_ROOT" && pwd -P)
fi

if [ -z "$BK_AVDK_ROOT" ]; then
  BK_AVDK_PARENT=$(CDPATH= cd -- "$OPENVELA_ROOT/.." && pwd -P)
  BK_AVDK_ROOT="$BK_AVDK_PARENT/bk_avdk_smp"
fi
[ -d "$BK_AVDK_ROOT" ] || fatal "Beken SDK root is not a directory: $BK_AVDK_ROOT"
BK_AVDK_ROOT=$(CDPATH= cd -- "$BK_AVDK_ROOT" && pwd -P)

for tool in git find sort cmp mktemp sha256sum realpath stat cp mv chmod \
  mkdir dirname sed grep awk wc rm; do
  command -v "$tool" >/dev/null 2>&1 || fatal "required tool not found: $tool"
done

# All rows have exactly eight tab-separated fields.  In addition to pinning the
# source revisions, each repository row locks the complete overlay path/content
# set by count and by a digest of sorted "relative-path<TAB>sha256" records.
if ! awk -F '\t' '
  function fail(message) {
    printf "prepare.sh: manifest:%d: %s\n", NR, message > "/dev/stderr"
    bad = 1
  }
  function is_hex(value, width) {
    return length(value) == width && value ~ /^[0-9a-f]+$/
  }

      } else if ($2 == "nuttx") {

      } else if ($2 == "packages_ai_agent") {

      bad = 1
    }
    if (archive_count != 1) {
      printf "prepare.sh: manifest: expected 1 archive row, found %d\n", archive_count > "/dev/stderr"
      bad = 1
    }
    exit bad
  }
' "$MANIFEST"; then
  exit 1
fi

TARGET_SNAPSHOT="$WORK_DIR/target-snapshot"

# managed file, including ram_regions.csv, remains byte-for-byte strict.
files_equal()
{

  fe_rel=$2
  fe_left=$3
  fe_right=$4

  ds_cursor=$ds_target
  ds_remaining=$ds_rel

    continue

  error "processed repository count changed: $repos_seen != 4"
fi
if [ "$manifest_managed" -ne "$EXPECTED_MANAGED" ]; then
  error "manifest managed-file count changed: $manifest_managed != $EXPECTED_MANAGED"
fi
if [ "$managed" -ne "$EXPECTED_MANAGED" ]; then
  error "overlay managed-file count changed: $managed != $EXPECTED_MANAGED"
fi
if [ "$MODE" = install ]; then
  snapshot_count=$(wc -l < "$TARGET_SNAPSHOT")
  if [ "$snapshot_count" -ne "$EXPECTED_MANAGED" ]; then
    error "install target snapshot is incomplete: $snapshot_count != $EXPECTED_MANAGED"
  fi
fi

if [ "$errors" -ne 0 ]; then
  echo "prepare.sh: $errors error(s); no managed files were written" >&2
  exit 1
fi

if [ "$MODE" = check ]; then
  echo "prepare.sh: overlay verified ($managed files, $newline_equivalent auto_partitions newline-equivalent)"
  exit 0
fi

# Stage every pending source and verify it still has the hash observed during
# the full preflight. A source mutation or copy failure therefore occurs before
# any target file is replaced.
staged_index=0
while IFS="$TAB" read -r name overlay_file target rel destination file_mode reason expected_kind expected_sha overlay_sha; do
  staged_index=$((staged_index + 1))
  stage_file="$STAGE_DIR/$staged_index"

  if ! current_overlay_sha=$(file_sha256 "$overlay_file"); then
    error "$name cannot re-hash overlay before staging: $rel"
    continue
  fi
  if [ "$current_overlay_sha" != "$overlay_sha" ]; then
    error "$name overlay changed during preflight: $rel"
    continue
  fi
  if ! cp -- "$overlay_file" "$stage_file" || ! chmod "$file_mode" "$stage_file"; then
    error "$name cannot stage overlay file: $rel"
    continue
  fi
  if ! staged_sha=$(file_sha256 "$stage_file") || [ "$staged_sha" != "$overlay_sha" ]; then
    error "$name staged copy verification failed: $rel"
    continue
  fi

  printf '%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\n' \
    "$name" "$stage_file" "$target" "$rel" "$destination" "$file_mode" \
    "$reason" "$expected_kind" "$expected_sha" >> "$STAGED_PLAN"
done < "$PLAN"

if [ "$errors" -ne 0 ]; then
  echo "prepare.sh: $errors staging error(s); no managed files were written" >&2
  exit 1
fi

# Revalidate all 56 overlay sources and destinations after staging and before
# the first replacement, including files that were already current.
while IFS="$TAB" read -r name overlay_file overlay_sha target rel destination expected_kind expected_sha; do
  if ! current_overlay_sha=$(file_sha256 "$overlay_file"); then
    error "$name cannot re-hash overlay during revalidation: $rel"
  elif [ "$current_overlay_sha" != "$overlay_sha" ]; then
    error "$name overlay changed during preflight: $rel"
  elif ! destination_path_safe "$target" "$rel"; then
    error "$name destination became unsafe during preflight: $rel"
  elif ! target_state_matches "$destination" "$expected_kind" "$expected_sha"; then
    error "$name target changed during preflight: $rel"
  fi
done < "$TARGET_SNAPSHOT"

if [ "$errors" -ne 0 ]; then
  echo "prepare.sh: $errors revalidation error(s); no managed files were written" >&2
  exit 1
fi

# Phase 2: each replacement uses a same-directory temporary file and rename.
# The operation is deliberately per-file atomic; interruption can leave a
# validated prefix installed, and rerunning install safely completes it.
while IFS="$TAB" read -r name stage_file target rel destination file_mode reason expected_kind expected_sha; do
  destination_path_safe "$target" "$rel" \
    || fatal "$name destination became unsafe before replacement: $rel"
  target_state_matches "$destination" "$expected_kind" "$expected_sha" \
    || fatal "$name target changed before replacement: $rel"

  parent=$(dirname -- "$destination")
  mkdir -p -- "$parent"
  destination_path_safe "$target" "$rel" \
    || fatal "$name destination became unsafe after creating its parent: $rel"

  ACTIVE_TMP=$(mktemp "$parent/.velasight-overlay.XXXXXX")
  cp -- "$stage_file" "$ACTIVE_TMP"
  chmod "$file_mode" "$ACTIVE_TMP"
  cmp -s -- "$stage_file" "$ACTIVE_TMP" \
    || fatal "$name temporary copy verification failed: $rel"
  mv -f -- "$ACTIVE_TMP" "$destination"
  ACTIVE_TMP=
  echo "prepare.sh: installed $name:$rel ($reason)"
done < "$STAGED_PLAN"

# Re-run the read-only verification after installation.
"$0" check --openvela-root "$OPENVELA_ROOT" --bk-avdk-root "$BK_AVDK_ROOT"
echo "prepare.sh: install complete ($planned changed, $ready already current)"

</content>
</file>

text:
我把 `prepare.sh` 完整读了一遍,流程分成"校验"和"安装"两条路径,共享同一套准备阶段。逐步拆解:

## 第 0 步:manifest 格式校验(两种模式都会做)

先用一段 awk 扫 `manifest.tsv` 的每一行,不满足下面任何一条就直接报错、整个脚本退出,连目标仓库都还没碰:

- 每行必须正好 8 个字段
- `repo` 这一类行:baseline commit 必须是 40 位十六进制、file_count 必须是正整数、digest 必须是 64 位十六进制
- 四个仓库(`apps`/`nuttx`/`packages_ai_agent`/`bk_avdk_smp`)各自的路径映射和文件数是硬编码死的,比如今天改完之后是 `packages_ai_agent mapping/count must be packages/ai_agent with 15 files`——写错数字这行就直接 fail
- 总行数必须正好 4 个 repo + 1 个 image + 1 个 archive

这一步纯粹是"manifest 本身有没有写对",跟磁盘上实际文件完全无关。

## 第一阶段:对每个仓库做只读检查(check 和 install 共用这段逻辑)

对 manifest 里的每一个 `repo` 行,依次做:

1. **路径映射核对**——manifest 里写的 overlay_path/target 必须跟脚本里硬编码的那份完全一致,防止 manifest 被改成指向别的目录
2. **目标必须是干净的 git 仓库根目录**——`git -C "$target" rev-parse --show-toplevel`,拿到的顶层目录必须和传进来的 target 相等,不能是子目录
3. **baseline commit 必须能在目标仓库里找到**——`git cat-file -e "$baseline^{commit}"`,找不到就是"你还没 fetch 这个仓库到这个 commit"
4. **判断 HEAD 和 baseline 的关系,分三种情况**:
   - HEAD 正好等于 baseline → `baseline_compatible=yes`
   - HEAD 是 baseline 的后代(`merge-base --is-ancestor`)→ 也算 `yes`,但打一条 warning:"managed paths are still checked byte-for-byte"(今天跑的时候 bk_avdk_smp 就走了这条)
   - 两者都不满足 → 直接 error,"refusing a non-reproducible repository lineage"——这仓库不知道跑到哪个分叉去了,不允许继续
5. **遍历 overlay 目录,拒绝任何符号链接或特殊文件**——`find ... ! -type d ! -type f`,有一个就整批拒绝
6. **对 overlay 目录下每个文件**:
   - 算它的 sha256,记进一个索引文件(`path\tsha256` 的格式)
   - 检查它对应的目标路径是否"安全"——`destination_path_safe` 会逐段检查路径上每一段都不是符号链接,且最终 realpath 解析后确实落在目标仓库根目录之内,防止 `../../etc/passwd` 这类逃逸
   - 用 `files_equal`(本质是 `cmp -s`,逐字节比较)看这个文件目标端和 overlay 端是否一致

## 第二阶段:根据"一致不一致"分叉,check 和 install 在这里开始不同

**如果一致**(`ready`)——两种模式都直接跳过,不动这个文件。

**如果不一致,且当前是 check 模式**——直接报错,区分两种情况:
```
$name overlay mismatch: $rel        # 目标存在但内容不对
$name overlay missing from target: $rel  # 目标压根不存在
```
check 到这里就完了,不会往下走任何"能不能覆盖"的判断,因为 check 本来就不写东西。

**如果不一致,且当前是 install 模式**——判断能不能覆盖,只接受三种情况之一(`can_install=yes`):
- **目标现在的内容,字节级等于 pinned baseline 那个 commit 里的原始文件**(用 `git cat-file blob "$baseline:$rel"` 取出原始内容再 `cmp`)→ `reason=baseline`
- **目标路径根本不存在**→ `reason=new`
- 一个特例:Beken 生成的 CP config 文件,如果开头有 `# Automatically generated file. DO NOT EDIT.` 这行标记且行数够多,也放行→ `reason=generated-config`

三种都不满足,直接报:
```
$name refuses to overwrite unknown modification: $rel
```
今天我就撞在这条上——旧 overlay 内容已经写进目标,新 overlay 又改了同一批文件,目标既不等于 baseline 也不等于新内容,被判定为"未知修改"拒绝覆盖,得先手动把目标 reset 回 baseline 才能过。

## 每个仓库处理完之后,做一次整体校验

单个文件之外,还要验证**这个仓库的 overlay 作为一整个集合**没有变过:

- 实际遍历到的文件数(`repo_files`)必须等于 manifest 里那一行写的 count
- 把索引文件(排好序的 `path\tsha256` 记录)整体再算一次 sha256,必须等于 manifest 里那一行的 digest

这一步保证的不是单个文件对不对,是"这个仓库该管的文件,一个不多一个不少,内容也都对得上"。

## 四个仓库都过了之后,全局收尾检查

- 实际处理的仓库数必须是 4
- manifest 里累加的文件总数、脚本实际扫到的文件总数,都必须等于脚本顶部硬编码的 `EXPECTED_MANAGED`(现在是 56)

只要前面任何一步出过错(`errors` 计数器不为 0),这里直接退出,**一个文件都不会被写**,check 模式打印错误列表结束,install 模式打印 `N error(s); no managed files were written` 结束。

## check 模式到这里就结束了

全过就打印:
```
prepare.sh: overlay verified (56 files, 1 auto_partitions newline-equivalent)
```
退出码 0。整个过程没有任何写操作。

## install 模式:先阶段性验证,再动手写,分三轮

install 模式在完成上面全部检查之后,不是马上写文件,还要再走三轮:

**Stage(暂存)**——把计划要写的每个 overlay 源文件先 `cp` 到一个临时目录,再重新算一次 hash,跟第一阶段记下来的 hash 比对。这是防止在第一阶段扫描完、还没开始写之前,overlay 源文件本身又被人改了——如果变了,直接报 `overlay changed during preflight`,不写。

**Revalidate(复检)**——对**全部 56 个受管文件**(不只是要改的那几个,包括本来就一致的)重新检查一遍目标当前状态是否还等于第一阶段记录的那个预期状态。这一步防的是"我在阶段一判断完可以覆盖,但阶段一和真正写之间那段时间,目标文件被别的进程改了"这种时间窗口问题(TOCTOU)。

**Write(写入)**——只有前两轮都干净,才真正开始写。每个文件的写法是:在目标同一个目录下 `mktemp` 一个临时文件,`cp` 内容进去,`chmod` 权限对齐,再 `cmp` 校验一次临时文件内容不多不少,最后 `mv` 原子改名成目标文件名。逐个文件独立完成这个动作,不是一次性事务——脚本注释里写得很直接:"中断了重跑 install 能安全地把已验证过的那部分补完"。

## install 收尾:自己验证自己

全部文件写完之后,脚本在最后一行**重新调用自己、以 check 模式跑一遍**:

```bash
"$0" check --openvela-root "$OPENVELA_ROOT" --bk-avdk-root "$BK_AVDK_ROOT"
echo "prepare.sh: install complete ($planned changed, $ready already current)"
```

也就是"我刚写完的东西,现在拿只读校验再验一遍",不是"写完就假设成功了"。今天实际跑出来的就是这个顺序:

```
prepare.sh: installed packages_ai_agent:include/agent_config.h (baseline)
prepare.sh: installed packages_ai_agent:src/voice/audio_playback.c (baseline)
prepare.sh: installed packages_ai_agent:src/voice/volc_tts_ws.c (baseline)
prepare.sh: overlay verified (56 files, 1 auto_partitions newline-equivalent)
prepare.sh: install complete (3 changed, 53 already current)
```

三个文件走 `baseline` 这条覆盖路径(它们改之前的内容正好等于 pinned baseline blob),剩下 53 个文件因为本来就一致,直接跳过没写。

## 这套流程和 `build_and_flash.sh` 怎么接上

`external/README.md` 里写了:构建脚本默认只做只读 check,发现没准备好就直接停;要写就得显式传 `--prepare-overlay` 才会走 install。也就是日常构建默认在"只验证不写"这一档,写入是需要主动要求的动作,不会在构建过程里悄悄发生。
用听得懂的人话结合文件流解释

把之前那套机制换成一个日常场景来说。

## 先搞清楚"两份文件"分别放在哪

想象公司里有两个抽屉:

- **抽屉 A**(`external/packages/ai_agent/`,在 contest 仓库里)——存档抽屉,放的是"这份代码最终定稿应该长什么样"
- **抽屉 B**(`packages/ai_agent/`,另一个独立仓库)——工地抽屉,工厂编译的时候,机器真正伸手去拿的是这个抽屉里的东西

这两个抽屉物理上不是一个东西,contest 仓库的历史记录不了抽屉 B 里发生的事——这也是为什么改代码不能直接冲进抽屉 B 改完就走人,必须先在抽屉 A 里存一份,再想办法搬过去。

`manifest.tsv` 就是贴在抽屉 A 门上的一张清单卡:"这个抽屉现在应该有 15 份文件,每份文件的指纹(hash)是多少,全部文件搓在一起的总指纹又是多少"。

## check——只是拿着清单去核对,手插兜里,啥都不碰

`prepare.sh check` 相当于一个稽核员,拿着抽屉 A 里的每份文件,跟抽屉 B 里对应位置的文件逐字比对(`cmp`,一个字节都不能差)。

- 全部对得上 → 写报告说"验证通过"
- 哪个不一样 → 写报告说"这份不一致",然后完事

稽核员**不会动手改任何东西**,他只负责说"一样"还是"不一样"。今天我改完三个文件后先跑了 check,报告直接说:

> `overlay mismatch: include/agent_config.h`

意思是"抽屉 A 里这份已经改了,抽屉 B 里还是旧的,不一样"——纯粹是一句事实陈述,没有任何后续动作。

## install——搬运工要动手了,但搬之前会先看一眼抽屉 B 里现在放的是什么

`prepare.sh install` 是那个真正会把抽屉 A 的东西搬进抽屉 B 的人。但他不是看见不一样就直接盖上去,他会先检查抽屉 B 那个位置**现在放的东西是什么来路**:

- 如果那个位置本来就是空的 → 放心搬,反正没东西可覆盖
- 如果那个位置放的东西,跟"最初从厂里(upstream)领出来、原封不动"的样子一模一样(没人碰过)→ 也放心搬,盖上去
- 如果那个位置的东西跟"原厂样子"不一样,跟"抽屉 A 要搬的新东西"也不一样 → 说明**有人偷偷动过抽屉 B 里的东西,而且这份改动没在任何地方存档**。搬运工这时候会直接停手,一份都不搬,先喊人来看

今天我就撞在最后这一档:抽屉 B 里那两个文件是"老版本的抽屉 A 内容",既不是原厂样子,也不是我这次要搬的新内容——所以被拒绝了,提示是:

> `refuses to overwrite unknown modification`

我得先把抽屉 B 那两个位置手动恢复成"原厂样子",搬运工才认得出"这是可以覆盖的状态",肯放行。

## 真正搬的时候,是"先放个新的,再改名字"

搬运工不会直接把抽屉 B 里的旧文件挖空了往里塞内容,他是拿一张新纸,把内容抄好,核对一遍抄得对不对,再把这张新纸**换名**成正式文件——原来那份旧文件在这一瞬间被替换掉,不存在"抄了一半"的中间状态。这样如果中途断电、进程被杀,顶多是这一份没换完,重跑一次 install 会接着把剩下的补完,不会出现半份文件。

## 搬完之后,搬运工自己叫稽核员再查一遍

装完全部文件,`install` 最后一步是自己再跑一次 `check`——相当于搬完东西,自己找稽核员把两个抽屉重新对一遍,确认真的一致了才敢说"装完了"。今天实际输出就是这个顺序:

```
installed packages_ai_agent:include/agent_config.h (baseline)
installed packages_ai_agent:src/voice/audio_playback.c (baseline)
installed packages_ai_agent:src/voice/volc_tts_ws.c (baseline)
overlay verified (56 files, ...)
install complete (3 changed, 53 already current)
```

前三行是"搬了这三份",第四行是"搬完自己核对了一遍,通过",第五行是总结"这次真正动了 3 份,剩下 53 份本来就一样没必要动"。

## 为什么要这么麻烦

说白了就一句话:**抽屉 A 是能提交、能被审的东西,抽屉 B 是真正参与编译出成品的东西**。这套流程存在的唯一目的,就是让这两个抽屉任何时候拿出来对,都能对上——check 负责发现"对不上了",install 负责"安全地对上",而且绝不允许在没搞清楚抽屉 B 现状之前就莽撞地覆盖别人可能还没保存的改动。
